text:
UConn football prepares for first road test of 2026 at Southern Miss
E. V. Madrid
The UConn Huskies will play their first road game of the 2026 season against the Southern Miss Golden Eagles in Hattiesburg, Mississippi, on Sept. 16. The game will be broadcast on ESPN+ and marks the first-ever meeting between the two programs.
Media coverage includes television coverage by ESPN+, with Jason Baker and Larry Boyd providing commentary. Radio coverage is available through the UConn Sports Network, featuring Adam Giardino, Wayne Norman, and Michael Johnson. Fans can also listen via Fox Sports 97-9 FM in Hartford and various affiliate stations across Connecticut, as well as online through The Varsity Network App and SiriusXM channels 269 and 978. Live statistics will be available at SouthernMiss.com.
UConn enters this matchup after a home loss to Maryland last weekend that ended a nine-game home winning streak at Pratt & Whitney Stadium at Rentschler Field. Quarterback Kalieb Osborne threw two touchdowns in that game, with wide receiver JD Willoughby catching his first career touchdown pass.
This season marks a new era for UConn football under head coach Jason Candle, who was named the program's 33rd head coach in December after ten seasons leading Toledo. During his tenure there, Candle guided Toledo to 81 wins—making him their all-time winningest coach—two Mid-American Conference championships (2017 and 2022), seven bowl appearances, and no losing seasons over ten years. He was recognized as MAC Coach of the Year in both 2017 and 2023.
Southern Miss is led by Blake Anderson in his first year as head coach following previous stints at Utah State and Arkansas State. The Golden Eagles have started their season with a win over Alcorn State followed by a loss to Auburn; they feature a roster overhaul with only two returning starters among seventy-four new players this fall. Quarterback Ethan Hampton has thrown for over three hundred yards across two games while running back Steven Robinson leads with one hundred seventy-four rushing yards and three touchdowns.
Historically, UConn has struggled against Sun Belt Conference teams but broke an earlier losing streak with a win over Georgia State in 2024; overall they are one win to three losses versus Sun Belt opponents since joining FBS competition.
